limitations: Local source/compiled Node and disposable PostgreSQL, not a published API image/registry/hosted/cluster/staging/production qualification. Compiled graph hash is scoped, not a complete image/SBOM.

CLI assumes trusted OS/DB access; no remote MFA/admin audit or permanent operator-command idempotency ledger. N07/N08 own controls/alerts/freshness; batch exit0 is not whole-queue health or capacity.

Earlier WIP gates precede final retry timestamp/default compatibility refinements; final worker-qualified and full checks apply to frozen source. All failed attempts retained.

No fresh full browser/mobile/store/hosted/public/operator/adult/media release approval. Known hosted cadence/enforcement unresolved, N13/N14 inactive, raw artifacts private local not off-host archived.

Private raw evidence remains local until owner cleanup, not off-host archived.
